checks.q: Is the JavaScript source code hardcoded or properly validated?
Are secrets properly encrypted and not exposed in the request?
Is the response properly validated for expected format and range?
Is the request properly bounded to prevent expensive computation costs?
Are error responses handled gracefully without blocking the protocol?
Is the DON (Decentralized Oracle Network) selection appropriate for the data sensitivity?
Are request/response pairs properly tracked to prevent confusion?
Is the subscription owner properly access-controlled?
